notificationLabView.title: Notification test bench
notificationLabView.subtitle: Checks on a real device that a break alarm actually wakes you up (T-13b).
notificationLabView.webWarning: Local notifications only exist in the Android app. On the web, every button below does nothing.

hints.alarm: MAX importance: heads-up banner and vibration. Its sound goes through USAGE_NOTIFICATION though, so silent mode should mute it.
hints.pluginDefault: The only channel using USAGE_ALARM, so it should ring even in silent mode — but at DEFAULT importance, so no banner. This comparison decides whether native code is needed.
hints.reminder: The habit reminder channel: neither alarm nor silent-mode bypass. Used as a control.

notificationLabView.logEmpty: Nothing yet. Actions received from a notification will show up here.

protocol.locked: Locked screen: does the alarm show on top of it, or do you have to unlock to see it?
protocol.silent: Silent mode and Do Not Disturb: does the sound still come through?
protocol.killed: App swiped away from recents: does the alarm still ring, and does "Snooze" relaunch the app?
protocol.doze: Phone left idle for 30 minutes (Doze): schedule at +20 min and compare the actual time to the planned one.
